## Earthworm Jim HD PC Port v0.9.3

### New: Cheats
A new **Cheats** page in the launcher ([#1](https://github.com/TekRantGaming/earthworm-jim-hd-recompiled/issues/1)):

- **Infinite health**: hits no longer drain Jim's health. Pits and other instant deaths still count.
- **Infinite lives**: Jim keeps his lives when he dies, so it is never Game Over.
- **Infinite ammo**: the plasma gun never runs low.
- **Rapid fire**: the plasma gun fires three times as fast.
- **High jump**: Jim jumps higher.
- **Fast run**: Jim runs half as fast again.

Every cheat is off by default. Turn them on or off on the Cheats page before you press **Play**; turning one off gives you the game's normal values back. They work in Jim's platform levels. Achievements can still be unlocked with cheats on.

### How to update
Open the launcher: it offers the update and installs it for you (or **About > Check now**). Your game files, saves and settings are kept.

### New install
- **Windows:** unzip **EarthwormJimHD-v0.9.3-windows-x64.zip** anywhere, run **earthworm_jim_hd.exe**, click **Install from package...** on the **Play** page and pick your own Earthworm Jim HD Xbox Live Arcade package (title ID `584109E2`, game version 1.0.0.11; see the README for the exact file).
- **Linux / Steam Deck:** download **EarthwormJimHD-v0.9.3-linux-x86_64.AppImage**, make it executable and run it; the README has the Steam Deck steps.

**No game files are included.**

Requires Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and a DirectX 12 graphics card, or a 64-bit Linux system / Steam Deck with Vulkan.
